summary:
Implementation plan for UAE Luxury Investment Platform Transformation:
1. Sovereign Luxury Visual Identity & Textures: Deep obsidian black (#090a0f), brushed gold (#d4af37, #f59e0b), and champagne accents (#fef3c7, #e2d9c8) with subtle golden hairline borders and rich dark gradients across the entire app.
2. High-Fidelity Golden Skeleton Screen Loader in UserDashboard: Shimmering gold-pulsed skeleton loader matching the exact visual card layout of investment plans while context investments and user data load.
3. Homepage UAE Luxury Property Showcase: Full luxury property cards matching the Buy Plans tab with high-res photography, verified Dubai address, occupancy rate, and weekly Friday cash yields.
4. Cohesive Premium Polish: Refined typography, unboxed metadata, and seamless state persistence with Supabase.
